{{Quote|Cease hostility!|A Jedi Temple Guard attempts to end the fight between Anakin Skywalker and Barriss Offee|<ref name="TWJ">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>}}
The '''Jedi Temple Guards''', also known as '''Jedi Temple Guardians<ref name="Sabotage" />''', were [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who were dedicated to protecting the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They served as part of the Jedi Temple's [[Temple Security Force|security force]] and reported to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]], who headed the Temple's [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security]] detail. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], members of the Guards participated in the [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|trial]] of the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was framed for the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] of the Jedi Temple Hangar. Four Jedi Temple Guards, along with Tano's Master, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], later escorted the actual culprit, the Jedi [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], to Coruscant's [[Republic military base]], where Offee confessed to the crimes, leading to Tano's exoneration. Later, some Temple Guards protected Jedi Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] as [[Gender/Legends|he]] was recovering from a [[Deprivation ritual/Legends|procedure]] done so that he could determine the [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|source]] of a voice in his [[Force vision/Legends|visions]].

==Description==
The [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] Guards were an ancient [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security]] group in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="JTG" /> The Guards, also known as Temple Guardians,<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> comprised various [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|sentinels]] in the Order. The position of Temple Guard was considered one of the duties that a Knight could adopt, and Knights were chosen as part of their continuing commitment to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The Jedi Temple Guards were tasked with the protection of the Jedi Temple on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and were a part of the [[Temple Security Force|security force]], reporting to the head of security.<ref name="JTG" />

==History==
===Anti-war protests===
[[File:JediTempleGuardian-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|A Jedi Temple Guardian as they appear during the [[Third Galactic War]].]]
The Jedi Temple Guards were established thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Galactic War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy–spanning]] war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Millennia later, the Jedi Temple Guards continued in their role as guardians for the Temple during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="JTG" /> a galactic conflict fought between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|began]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Around the war's [[20 BBY/Legends|second year]],<ref name="DM:DS 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> the Jedi Temple's hangar was [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombed]], [[Death/Legends|killing]]<ref name="Sabotage" /> six Jedi,<ref name="TJWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and a number of [[Temple employee]]s. During the investigation, a group of citizens gathered at the Temple's steps to protest the Jedi's involvement in the war. Two Temple Guards stood watch at the steps, along with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]], their security chief, as the citizens continued their protest.<ref name="Sabotage" />

[[File:Jedi_guards_at_rally.png|thumb|right|250px|Two Jedi Temple Guards stand outside the Jedi Temple during an anti-war rally.]]After a [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|memorial service]] was held for the Jedi victims of the Temple [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bombing,<ref name="TJWKTM" /> the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was accused of orchestrating the [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] and the murder of Republic citizen [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]], who was secretly involved in the bombing. Tano was eventually [[Capture of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|captured]] by [[Gender/Legends|her]] Master, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the Republic security forces.<ref name="TCaJ">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> Members of the Jedi Temple Guards helped escort Tano to the [[Chamber of Judgment/Legends|Chamber of Judgment]], where the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] questioned Tano about the charges levied against her. When the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]] expelled her from the Order so that she could be [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|tried]] by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], two of the Guards activated their [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pikes]] and blocked Skywalker following his objection to the ruling, while one of the Guards removed Tano's [[Padawan braid/Legends|Padawan braid]].<ref name="TWJ" />

===Chasing Barriss Offee===
[[File:BarrissInCourt-TWJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Jedi Temple Guards, lightsaber pikes drawn, escort the fugitive Jedi Barriss Offee.]]
Skywalker soon discovered that the actual perpetrator of the crimes was the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] Jedi [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], a friend of Tano's. Skywalker [[Duel at the Jedi Temple/Legends|confronted]] Offee in the Temple's [[Jedi Temple dormitory|dormitories]], but she attempted to flee from him, only to be blocked by the Temple Guards. As the ensuing [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] between Skywalker and Offee progressed to the rooftop of the Temple's [[Ziggurat/Legends|ziggurat]], the Temple Guards activated their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and continued to surround Offee and Skywalker in order to protect Jedi Master [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and a nearby class of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] from harm. After Skywalker finally [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|defeated]] and apprehended Offee, four members of the Guard escorted her to the [[Republic military base]], where Tano was being tried, and Offee confessed to the Temple bombing and Turmond's murder. The Guards later escorted Offee out of the court when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who was officiating her subsequent trial, ordered her to be taken away.<ref name="TWJ" />

Later during the war, Jedi Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] underwent a [[Deprivation ritual/Legends|deprivation ritual]] in an attempt to ascertain the [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|source of the voice]] he had been hearing in his [[Force vision/Legends|visions]]. After the procedure, Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] tasked three Jedi Temple Guards with watching over Yoda as he recovered. However, Yoda convinced Anakin Skywalker to help him evade the Guards by pretending to accompany Yoda for a walk. The two Guards standing by the exit from the recovery room tried to halt Yoda's progress, but Skywalker assured them that he would watch over Yoda. The Jedi Master then proceeded to leave the Temple in his [[Yoda's fighter/Legends|personal Jedi starfighter]].<ref name="Voices">{{TCW|Voices}}</ref>

==Equipment and skills==
Jedi Temple Guards wore formal [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] and ivory masks with gold marks, a show of emotional detachment that was required in service to a higher calling. Temple Guards carried large double-bladed lightsaber [[Pike/Legends|pikes]] that produced yellow [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|blades]], which were rare among Jedi of the [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="JTG" />

Jedi Temple Guards carried a set of keys on their belts, which unlocked many areas of the Jedi Temple as well as restricted areas. The Temple Guard were quite skilled swordsmen, as well as using [[Form VI/Legends|Form VI Niman]] and [[Form III/Legends|Form III Soresu]]. But there was a majority that used Form VI more than the Form III, but nevertheless they had an important control in both forms of combat.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LightsaberPikeConcept.png|thumb|right|180px|Jedi Temple Guard lightsaber pike concept art]]
The Jedi Temple Guards were first introduced in "[[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]]," the seventeenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="SabotageGuide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sabotage-episode-guide|text="Sabotage" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> which aired on [[February 9]], [[2013]].<ref name="SabotageDate">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-the-clone-wars/the-sabotage-2642607|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars &ndash; Season 5, Episode 17: The Sabotage}}</ref> Although not identified in the episode itself,<ref name="Sabotage" /> the security detail was given a title in the episode's [http://starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep517/#!/media/slideshow accompanying guide] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="SabotageGuide" />

The Guards later appeared in two subsequent episodes of the series, "[[The Wrong Jedi]]" from Season Five<ref name="The Wrong Jedi Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep520|text="The Wrong Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> and "[[Voices]]" from the series' [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]],<ref name="VoicesGuide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep611|text="Voices" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> and were also given an [http://starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep520/#!/about entry] in the StarWars.com [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]].<ref name="JTG" /> "The Wrong Jedi" was the first episode to show the Temple Guards in action with their double-bladed lightsaber pikes, which were the first lightsabers in cinematic [[canon]] to be depicted with a yellow blade. In the episode's planning stages, the lightsaber pikes were originally to be green.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi Guide" /> A version of the Temple Guard armor appears as the "Temple Guardian" armor set in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it was one of the items available in the Club Vertica Nightlife Pack on the in-game Cartel Market.<ref name="TOR" />
